capture.setup: default.conf: `location = /stub_status { stub_status; }`, `/app/` proxied to an upstream of two nginx:alpine containers, :443 TLS server; 25 requests through /app/
capture.command: apps/collectors/cmd/nginx invoked with target http://127.0.0.1:19580 (proxy -> container :80), options {}; the collector first asks for the NGINX Plus API (/api/, answered 404 by open-source NGINX) and then reads /stub_status; recording HTTP proxy (throwaway lab tool, not checked in) between the collector and the container; it stores each response status, Content-Type/Server/ETag headers and the body bytes unchanged; request Authorization headers are forwarded and never stored
